description: Ministry of Higher Education, Technology & Innovations - Amendment to the Gaz.Ex.No. 2164/53 of 27.02.2020 University of Sri Jayawardanapura
reasoning: This gazette content involves a legal/regulatory amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an Order issued by the Minister that modifies the schedule specifying faculties and departments at the University of Sri Jayewardenepura. The content focuses on statutory instruments and regulatory modifications rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories.
